title: Worldwide maps
verification_method: Official Protomaps mirror linked by its download documentation. Header and metadata were fetched with bounded HTTPS byte-range requests on November 3, 2026. Content-Range reports the exact total bytes. PMTiles v3, vector tiles, zooms 0–15, compatible kind-based Protomaps layers. The complete archive was not downloaded or hashed during catalog verification.

options.name: Worldwide street map · all countries
options.description: One worldwide OpenStreetMap-derived basemap, zoom levels 0–15, with roads, place labels, buildings and land features. This is a street basemap, not satellite imagery, nautical charts, every trail or a routing database. OSM coverage varies. Importing currently needs temporary space for another copy; remove the downloaded copy only after verifying the map import.
options.checksum_note: No SHA-256 is published for this mirror. The multipart ETag is not a file checksum. Exact length and PMTiles structure are checked; cryptographic integrity is not established.
